Details
  • Paper: WD ViT Tagger v3, Model card, 2024-03-04
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models at 0df212b369a5
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/SmilingWolf/wd-vit-tagger-v3/blob/7f6b584d0bd3f55c4531f14ba3d4761b2bccdc0f/README.md
  • Training data: Danbooru (anime illustrations with community tags; WD taggers: image ids up to 7 220 105)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: wd-vit-tagger-v3, wd-convnext-tagger-v3, wd-vit-large-tagger-v3, wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3
  • Outputs: logits; label_set: wd-tagger-v3; probs: sigmoid
  • Input size: fixed 448x448: the input is resized (short side 448) and centre-cropped to it
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): wd-vit-tagger-v3 448x448 (0.2 GiB peak allocated, 0.3 reserved); wd-convnext-tagger-v3 448x448 (0.3 GiB peak allocated, 0.4 reserved); wd-vit-large-tagger-v3 448x448 (0.7 GiB peak allocated, 0.7 reserved); wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3 448x448 (0.7 GiB peak allocated, 0.9 reserved)
  • wd-vit-tagger-v3 448x448, first call: portable + torch.compile 10 s (cold Inductor cache).
  • wd-convnext-tagger-v3 448x448, first call: portable + torch.compile 12 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 40 s (ONNX + engine).
  • wd-vit-large-tagger-v3 448x448, first call: portable + torch.compile 14 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 36 s (ONNX + engine).
  • wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3 448x448, first call: portable + torch.compile 22 s (cold Inductor cache).
  • wd-vit-tagger-v3 original 448x448: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs
  • wd-convnext-tagger-v3 original 448x448: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs
  • wd-vit-large-tagger-v3 original 448x448: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs
  • wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3 original 448x448: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs
  • wd-vit-tagger-v3 load / first call: original 2.33 s / 0.318 s (448x448), portable 2.44 s / 0.09 s (448x448), kernels 2.28 s / 0.092 s (448x448)
  • wd-convnext-tagger-v3 load / first call: original 2.92 s / 0.484 s (448x448), portable 2.72 s / 0.273 s (448x448), kernels 2.4 s / 0.096 s (448x448)
  • wd-vit-large-tagger-v3 load / first call: original 4.74 s / 0.439 s (448x448), portable 5.54 s / 0.091 s (448x448), kernels 4.68 s / 0.063 s (448x448)
  • wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3 load / first call: original 4.82 s / 0.352 s (448x448), portable 5.38 s / 0.064 s (448x448), kernels 3.61 s / 0.076 s (448x448)
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1.5e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.015 and p99 <= 0.052 (absolute error of the output logits).

Limitations

  • An image with an alpha channel is not composited on white first, as the reference script does: pass RGB.
